script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LOCKER ROOM - DAY

A freshman, JASON (20), enters the bustling locker room of the prestigious university's soccer team. The room is filled with seasoned upperclassmen, chattering and laughing.

JASON
(nervous)
Hi, I'm Jason. I just joined the team.

No one responds. He sets his bag down and begins to undress.

INT. SOCCER FIELD - DAY

The team practices, focusing on technical drills and coordinated plays. Jason struggles to keep up, feeling out of place.

Suddenly, the coach BEN (40), a stern but fair figure, calls out to Jason.

BEN
(yelling)
Jason! You're on my team. Time to step up.

INT. SOCCER FIELD - LATER

After practice, Jason approaches Ben, eager to prove himself.

JASON
(confident)
Coach, I want to do better. I'll work hard.

BEN
(smiling)
I believe in you, Jason. But remember, it's not just about your skills. It's about the team.

INT. CAMPUS CAFETERIA - NIGHT

Jason sits alone, feeling isolated. A teammate, MARK (22), approaches and invites him to join his study group. They hit it off, bonding over shared interests and goals.

MARK
(grinning)
I'm glad you're on the team, Jason. You're not alone here.

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

Mark and Jason study together, sharing tips and jokes. They form a strong bond, but Jason becomes increasingly aware of Mark's personal struggles.

MARK
(sighing)
My family's having financial troubles. I have to work two jobs just to get by.

INT. SOCCER FIELD - NIGHT

The team practices under the stars, their camaraderie shining through. Jason and Mark talk, and Jason reveals his own struggles - feeling like an outsider on the team.

MARK
(encouraging)
You don't need to prove yourself to anyone, Jason. We all believe in you.

INT. CAMPUS CENTER - DAY

The team gathers for a team-building exercise, splitting into pairs for a trust-building game. Jason and Mark are partnered together. They share personal stories and laughs, forming an even stronger bond.

INT. SOCCER GAME - DAY

During a crucial game, Jason makes a crucial mistake, causing the team to fall behind. Mark rallies the team, reminding them of their bond and determination to succeed. They win the game.

INT. LOCKER ROOM - NIGHT

After the game, the team showers and celebrates their victory. Jason and Mark exchange knowing glances, realizing their friendship is what carried them through.

MARK
(smiling)
I'm proud of us, Jason. We did it.

JASON
(grinning)
Yeah, we did.

FADE OUT.
